# hybrid-search-lite

> In-memory hybrid search fusing BM25 and cosine vector rankings with reciprocal rank fusion, metadata filters and pickle-free SQLite persistence Python package `trysac-hybrid-search-lite`, import name `hybrid_search_lite`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
